name: Scroll of Protection (Fiend)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Read
powers.text: Magic action: for 5 minutes, Fiends can't willingly move within 5 ft of you or reach you with attacks (a DC 15 Cha save lets one push through).

summary: For 5 minutes, Fiends can't come within 5 ft of you or reach you (DC 15 Cha save breaks through).
text: Reading the scroll takes a Magic action and surrounds you with an invisible cylinder 5 feet in radius and 10 feet tall, which stays centered on you as you move. For 5 minutes, Fiends can't enter it or affect anything inside it. If your movement brings a Fiend inside the cylinder, the protection collapses. Any creature may spend an action on a Charisma check (DC 15) to break through; if it succeeds, the barrier stops affecting it.
